{#- Penawaran ke customer, dicetak dari Sales Order -#} {#- Syarat penawarannya diketik di Quotation. Print format ini bisa dipasang di dua doctype: - dicetak dari Quotation -> field-nya dibaca dari dokumen itu sendiri - dicetak dari Sales Order -> dibaca dari Quotation asalnya (nomornya nempel di baris item) -#} {%- set terms = ["valid_till", "custom_payment_terms", "custom_delivery_point", "custom_delivery_time", "custom_validity", "custom_subject"] -%} {%- set quotation = doc.name if doc.doctype == "Quotation" else (doc.items[0].prevdoc_docname if doc.items and doc.items[0].prevdoc_docname else None) -%} {%- set source = frappe.db.get_value("Quotation", quotation, terms, as_dict=True) if quotation else None -%} {%- set valid_till = source.valid_till if source else None -%} {%- set currency = doc.currency -%}
{%- include "vic_addon/templates/print_formats/vic_letterhead.html" -%}
QUOTATION
Quotation No. : {{ doc.name }}
Date : {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.transaction_date, "MMMM d, yyyy") }}
{{ doc.customer_name or doc.get("customer") or doc.get("party_name") }}
{#- kalau di Quotation-nya dikosongin, jatuh ke teks yang selama ini dipakai di form kertas -#}
Payment Terms : {{ (source.custom_payment_terms if source else None) or doc.get("payment_terms_template") or doc.get("tc_name") or "" }}
Delivery Point : {{ (source.custom_delivery_point if source else None) or doc.get("shipping_address_name") or "" }}
Validity : {{ (source.custom_validity if source else None) or (frappe.utils.formatdate(valid_till, "MMMM d, yyyy") if valid_till else "") }}
Delivery Time: {{ (source.custom_delivery_time if source else None) or "Reconfrom stock before PO" }}
Your Ref : {{ doc.contact_display or doc.get("po_no") or "" }}
Subject : {{ (source.custom_subject if source else None) or "" }}
{%- set ns = namespace(no = 0) %} {%- for header, rows in group_items_by_header(doc.items) %} {%- set indent = "indent" if header else "" %} {%- if header %} {%- endif %} {%- for item in rows %} {%- set ns.no = ns.no + 1 %} {%- set size = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item.item_code, "custom_size") %} {%- set qty = item.qty | float %} {%- endfor %} {%- endfor %}
Item Description Qty Unit Price
{{ currency }}
 Total Price
{{ currency }}
{{ header }}
{{ ns.no }}
{{ item.item_name }}
{%- if size %}
Size : {{ size }}
{% endif %} 		{{ qty | int if qty == qty | round(0) else "%.2f" | format(qty) }} {{ item.uom }} {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(item.rate) }} {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(item.amount) }}
{%- for tax in doc.taxes %} {%- endfor %}
TOTAL PRICE {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.total) }}
{{ tax.description }} {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(tax.tax_amount) }}
GRAND TOTAL PRICE {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.grand_total) }}
Best regards,
{{ frappe.db.get_value("User", doc.owner, "full_name") or "" }}
{%- include "vic_addon/templates/print_formats/vic_footer.html" -%}
